null.config.event_max_speed_boost: Most extra pace from the speed settings
null.showcase.title: NULL showcase
null.showcase.start.full: a guided tour through all six stages, %s s per step.
null.showcase.start.help: Every step is named on your action bar. /null showcase next skips ahead, /null showcase <seconds> changes the pace, /null showcase stop ends the tour. Afterwards the world's stage and its progress, the speed, the pause state and the time of day are put back, and if the tour took you to another place you are brought back to where you stood.
null.showcase.start.others: Other players are online: the stages change for them as well.
null.showcase.start.later: Your world is at Stage %s %s: while the tour shows the earlier stages, what only belongs to the later ones (corrupted and parasite mobs, NULLROOT, Visitors, simulated players) goes away, and comes back over time afterwards.
null.showcase.stopping: The showcase ends; everything is being put back.
null.showcase.error.running: A showcase is already running (for %s). /null showcase stop ends it.
null.showcase.end.logout: The showcase ended because its viewer left; the world's stage, speed and pause state are back.
null.showcase.end.server: The showcase ended with the server; the world's stage, speed and pause state are back.
null.showcase.end.reset: The showcase ended: NULL was reset.
null.showcase.end.stage_changed: The showcase ended: the stage was changed from outside the tour, and stays as it was set.
null.showcase.end.summary: %s steps shown, %s could not happen here. The world is at Stage %s %s again.
null.showcase.hint.list: watch the chat and the player list
null.showcase.hint.stay_inside: stay inside: IT takes whoever is out in the open
null.showcase.problem.world_off: world changes are switched off in the config
null.showcase.problem.failed: found no place for it here
null.showcase.warn.unreachable: The showcase could not take you to %s; that stage goes on where you are.
